drop_hint: Drop music files or a folder here
msg_no_results: No results. Edit the query or try Find by sound
msg_batch_done: Search finished: {auto} of {total} files auto-selected. Review the list, then press Save all
msg_cover_failed: Cover art could not be downloaded; text tags were saved
msg_no_selection: Pick a candidate in the table first
msg_restored_exact: Restored the original file (byte for byte): {name}
err_rate_limit_failed: The search could not finish because of request limits. Try again in a moment
err_fpcalc_missing: Fingerprint tool (fpcalc) not found. Put fpcalc.exe in the third_party folder or set fpcalc_path in settings.json
err_acoustid_key: AcoustID API key missing or expired. Get a key at acoustid.org and put it in acoustid_key in settings.json
err_readonly: File is read-only or in use
cli_desc: Fills title, artist, album and cover art into untagged music files. Files are never uploaded; only the query and an audio fingerprint are sent.
cli_auto: Save without asking when the match is {score} or higher
cli_overwrite: Overwrite existing tags and cover with the candidate (--auto only fills empty fields by default)
cli_sound: Find by sound instead of by text
cli_undo: Restore the original tags from the backup (.tagbak.json)
cli_help: show this help message and exit
cli_auto_skipped: best match {score} is below the bar, skipping
